if.test: query.terminal != null and query.terminal != '' and query.terminal != '全部'
query.requestStatus != null and query.requestStatus != '' and query.requestStatus != '全部'

choose.when: AND pa.attempt_status IN ('处理中', '待人工确认', '渠道提交中')

mapper.sql: (SELECT FROM t_payment_order p WHERE p.payment_order_id = po.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) AND CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1) AS successFactIssue

LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))

LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.prepay_order_no) AND CAST(pr.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))

LEFT JOIN t_payment_route_record attempt_route ON attempt_route.id = ( SELECT prr.id FROM t_payment_route_record prr WHERE prr.attempt_no = pa.attempt_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(prr.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) AND CAST(prr.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) AND prr.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY prr.created_at DESC, prr.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT pa.attempt_no AS requestNo, pa.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pa.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, po.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, pa.source_app_id AS sourceAppId, pa.channel_code AS channelCode, attempt_route.route_no AS routeNo, attempt_route.route_rule AS routeRule, attempt_route.route_result AS routeResult, attempt_route.ops_config_snapshot_version AS routeOpsConfigSnapshotVersion, pa.terminal AS terminal, pa.client_ip AS clientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, pa.attempt_status AS requestStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS requestStatusType, pa.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, DATE_FORMAT(pa.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
FROM t_payment_attempt pa
LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = po.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(standard_order.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.order_no) AND CAST(standard_order.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.order_no = po.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.order_no) AND CAST(pr.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.source_kind = 'STANDARD_ORDER' AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.source_kind) = CHAR_LENGTH('STANDARD_ORDER') AND CAST(pr.source_kind AS BINARY(16)) = CAST('STANDARD_ORDER' AS BINARY(16))
WHERE pa.attempt_no = #{requestNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{requestNo}) AND CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{requestNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.attempt_no AS requestNo, pa.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pa.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, po.order_no AS orderNo, pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, pa.channel_code AS channelCode, attempt_route.route_result AS routeResult, pa.terminal AS terminal, pa.client_ip AS clientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, pa.attempt_status AS requestStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS requestStatusType, pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
FROM t_payment_attempt pa
LIMIT 1001
